name: The Frank household at 1608 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_frank_henry_l

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1608 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1608 Mr. & Mrs. Henry L. Frank.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1608, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 36, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The two live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Henry L. Frank
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Henry L. Frank here as head, born December 1839, in Germany, came to the United States in 1852, married, real estate dealer (ED 36, sheet 3A, line 5, leaf n669).

persons.name: Mrs. Henry L. Frank
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Henriette Frank here as wife, born June 1854, in Illinois, married (ED 36, sheet 3A, line 6, leaf n669).

persons.name: Maggie Biehl

born.note: The census gives March 1861, age 39 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Cook" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (cook); born March 1861, in Pennsylvania, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904.
